content.text: When mom and dad teach you how to make the healthiest creamy soups without the
heavy cream, you never look back. Let's go! To a pot, add a touch of
oil with onions, carrots, celery, and garlic. Saute for a few minutes, add the salt
and pepper, cauliflower, and potato. Now add the broth, bring to a boil, reduce the
heat, and then semi -cover it until it's fully cooked. Transfer into a blender, blend,
enjoy, and don't forget, follow for more!
